title: Present continuous — scopri la regola
topicTag: Present continuous · am / is / are + -ing · isn't / aren't · Are you…?

questions.text:

❓ Le azioni evidenziate (I'm doing, is reading, are playing…) **quando** succedono?
options: Ogni sabato: sono abitudini della famiglia
Adesso, mentre Lisa parla al telefono con la nonna

questions.text:
✍️ **Ora scrivi tu la regola!** Clicca le parole giuste.
Il Present continuous si forma con il verbo [[have (have / has)|be (am / is / are)|do (do / does)]] + il verbo con [[-s|-ed|-ing]].
Con **I** si usa [[is|am|are]]; con **he / she / it** si usa [[are|am|is]]; con **you / we / they** si usa [[are|is|am]].
I'm, Dad's, they're sono le forme [[negative|contratte]] di I am, Dad is, they are.
Si usa per azioni che succedono [[tutti i giorni, per abitudine|adesso, nel momento in cui si parla]].
answers: adesso, nel momento in cui si parla

questions.text:
👀 **Avevi ragione?** Controlla la regola qui sopra.

❓ **Which is correct?**

Complete with **am**, **is** or **are**.
Look! The baby [[am|is|are]] sleeping.
I [[am|is|are]] listening to music now.
My friends [[am|is|are]] waiting for the bus.
Shh! Dad [[am|is|are]] talking on the phone.

✍️ **Look around you!** What are your classmates and your teacher doing **now**? Write 3 sentences.
*Example: Giulia is writing. The teacher is talking. We're sitting at our desks.*
🙋 **Hai capito la forma affermativa del PRESENT CONTINUOUS?**
options: ✅ Sì prof, tutto chiaro! — It's all clear!
🤔 Ho qualche dubbio — I've got some doubts
❌ Non ci ho capito niente — I didn't get a thing!

questions.text:
🔍 **Guarda i tre gruppi di verbi.** Che cosa succede quando aggiungo **-ing**?
Gruppo 1 (play, read, study): aggiungo -ing e il verbo [[perde l'ultima lettera|non cambia]].
Gruppo 2 (make, dance, write): la **-e** finale [[raddoppia|resta|cade]].
Gruppo 3 (sit, swim, run): sono verbi brevi che finiscono con consonante + vocale + consonante: l'ultima consonante [[raddoppia|cade]].
👀 **Avevi ragione?** Controlla la regola, poi trascina ogni verbo nella colonna giusta.

📸 Look at the picture and complete with the **-ing** form.
**Look! Tom is ___ in the pool.** (swim)

📸 Look at the picture and complete with the **-ing** form.
**Lisa is ___ a letter to Grandma.** (write)

📸 Look at the picture and complete with the **-ing** form.
**Tom and Sam are ___ football in the park.** (play)

🔍 **La mamma chiama dal lavoro.** Leggi la telefonata.

❓ "Tom **isn't doing** his homework" vuol dire…
options: Tom non fa mai i compiti
In questo momento Tom non sta facendo i compiti
Tom ha già finito i compiti
questions.ttsText: Mum (on the phone): Hi kids! I hope you're doing your homework! Lisa: Mum, Tom isn't doing his homework. He's playing! Tom: That's not true! I'm not playing. I'm studying! Lisa: Tom and Sam aren't studying. They're eating crisps! Mum: And Lisa, you aren't studying. You're chatting!

questions.text:
🔍 Tom dice "I**'m not** playing", Lisa dice "Tom **isn't**" e "Tom and Sam **aren't**".

❓ Che cosa cambia da una frase all'altra?
options: Si usa don't / doesn't, come nel Present simple
Niente: isn't e aren't si usano a caso
Solo am / is / are, secondo il soggetto: poi aggiungo not

questions.text:
✍️ **Scrivi tu la regola!**
Per la frase negativa aggiungo **not** dopo [[il verbo in -ing|am / is / are]].
I → I [[amn't|'m not]] playing.
he / she / it → [[doesn't|aren't|isn't]] playing.
you / we / they → [[aren't|don't|isn't]] playing.
Il verbo resta [[alla forma base|con -ing]]: Tom isn't doing his homework.

👀 **Avevi ragione?** Controlla la regola qui sopra.

❓ **Which is correct?**
options: She not listening to the teacher.
She isn't listening to the teacher.
She isn't listen to the teacher.
She doesn't listening to the teacher.

questions.text:
Complete with **'m not**, **isn't** or **aren't**.
I [['m not|isn't|aren't]] wearing a hat today.
My parents [[isn't|aren't|'m not]] working now: they're at home.
Look! The cat [[aren't|'m not|isn't]] eating its food.
We [[aren't|isn't|'m not]] sleeping in class!
🔀 Put the words in order to make a **negative** sentence.

✍️ **Your turn!** Correct the sentences so they are true for you.
1. You're wearing a school uniform.
2. You're sitting in your kitchen.
3. You're doing a maths exercise.
*Example: I'm not wearing a school uniform. I'm wearing jeans and a T-shirt.*

🔍 **Sam telefona a Tom.** Guarda come iniziano le domande e come rispondono.
Per fare la domanda metto all'inizio [[Do / Does|Am / Is / Are]], poi il soggetto e il verbo con -ing.
Con Lisa (she) uso [[Are|Is]]; con Inter (they) uso [[Is|Are]].
Sam risponde "Yes, I [['m|do|am]]" e Tom risponde "No, she [[doesn't|isn't]]".
questions.ttsText: Sam: Hi Tom! What are you doing? Tom: I'm watching the match on TV. Are you watching it? Sam: Yes, I am! Is Lisa watching it with you? Tom: No, she isn't. She's reading in her room. Sam: Are Inter winning? Tom: Yes, they are! 2–0! ⚽ Forza Inter!

❓ **Are you listening to me?** ✅

Complete the questions and the short answers.
[[Am|Is|Are]] Jason helping you? ❌ No, he [[doesn't|aren't|isn't]].
[[Is|Are|Am]] you waiting for Daniel? ✅ Yes, I [['m|am|do]].
[[Are|Is|Am]] the students doing a test? ✅ Yes, they [[do|is|are]].
[[Is|Are|Am]] Hannah sleeping? ❌ No, she [[isn't|aren't|doesn't]].
🔀 Put the words in order to make a **question**.
sentences: Are they waiting for the bus?
